notes.title: 2.0 Hotfix 3?
notes.content: I add new controls to check the achievement system. Also, you can now see collected local achievements in-game menu. I'm tired of having achievement problems in every game i create...

notes.title: 2.0 Hotfix 2
notes.content:
Fixes:
- I changed achievement logic for World achievements.
- I wrote local achievement controllers. It controls your achievement in-game and adds your Steam account. And reversed version of this. (I hope so)
- Also i changed all levels a bit. (Really, a bit)

notes.title: 2.0 Hotfix 1
notes.content:
Fixed:
- Achievements could not be obtained.
- There were achievements that I forgot to add.

notes.title: Update 2.0 is out!
notes.content:
Since it was my first game on Steam, it was important to me, although it failed. It was a game I thought was fun, but I couldn't develop it in an interesting way. After two years of Steam adventure, I try to do something again. Although there are not big differences between older versions, I will do my best to attract attention. Now, let's see what's in the new version.

- A completely new game. Yes, I wrote it all over again. I included many of my previous achievements in this version.
- 10 maps. There were 6 in the previous game, this time there are 10. Maybe I will increase their numbers over time.
- I used a well-known 3D model set published on the market. Thus, each model of the game will adopt the same style.
- More active gameplay. Apart from running like crazy, you now have the possibility to climb.

notes.title: Improvements #2
notes.content:
- The zone required for Double Jumping is now indicated by the signs and "Follow".
- The first "F" key was added to the first map to make it easier to understand for the interaction of the first "F" key.
- Added extra cards to the first map.
- Now the selected language is recorded after you have changed languages. So every time you log in you will not have to change language.

notes.title: Improvements
notes.content:
- Map selection menu changed
- The "Lost" menu will no longer be encountered after you have dropped from a certain distance. After passing the character drop point, it will be beamed back to the birth point of the map.
- In the Settings tab, the Post-Process option changed the Graphic option, which was removed.
- The settings chosen by the player will now be saved instead of being reset. The deletion of the player record will not affect the record file in which the settings are kept.
- Packing of the game is renewed.
